freeze_rule: An external create-only manifest may freeze the audited candidate bytes; this contract is never edited to claim frozen status.

tension.preserve_boundary: JSON boolean true or false; strings are forbidden

audit.selected_choice: one exact closed option, chosen without seeing the candidate choice

capture_and_scoring.assistant_final_messages_binding: canonical minified array bytes plus sha256 and byte count
capture_and_scoring.single_text_output_binding: exact UTF-8 string plus sha256 and byte count, or all three null
capture_and_scoring.receipt_binding: capture envelope binds the exact derived receipt storage sha256 and bytes; harness independently reopens and compares identity, final-message, text, prohibited-activity, and observation fields

classes: missing final content or rejected multiple-final content
wrong type, shape, closed option, or enum

capture_and_scoring.text_normalization_receipt_binding: Harness independently recomputes a typed receipt from raw final messages, legacy single-text extraction, prohibited activity, and conformance observations; receipt is bound identically in capture and driver receipt.

idempotent_duplicate_final_policy.scope: transport-level response text selection only; semantic scoring remains unchanged
apply_if: at least two assistant final messages
every final has exactly one output_text item
all exact UTF-8 text bytes are byte-identical
the sole conformance observation is assistant_final_message_count_not_one
idempotent_duplicate_final_policy.effect: use the exact common UTF-8 bytes as scoring text while retaining raw final messages, count, hashes, observations, and an APPLIED_IDENTICAL_DUPLICATE_FINALS receipt

model_owned: one closed option choice per S10 decision
one semantic verdict per edge candidate
one preserve_boundary JSON boolean per all-claims-supported tension candidate
one answer-first closed option choice per non-direct S30 decision
unchanged R6-v7 S50 semantic edge verdicts
deterministic: decision ID, evidence_record_ids lineage, authority, and fixed envelope fields
exact source joins and context selectors
source-blind complete-claim-support compilation, unsupported exclusion, resolved routing, and final projection
edge and tension IDs and ordering
S30 candidate choice hiding, comparison, verdict, finding shape, lineage, classification, and ordering
boolean versus string versus null type enforcement
S40, S45, S50 direct authority projection, S55, S60 joins, S70, S80, and S90

decomposition.s10_decisions: one decision per subject call for both topics; provider returns selected_choice only
decomposition.s10_edges: one edge candidate per subject call for both topics; provider returns verdict only
decomposition.s10_tensions: source-blind fixture compilation excludes every candidate with any unsupported claim before rendering; every all-supported candidate gets one preserve_boundary boolean objective; true selects and false resolves/omits
decomposition.s30: one non-direct decision per answer-first subject call; candidate value is absent from provider bytes; reducer compares independently selected option to hidden candidate
decomposition.s50_s60: reuse frozen R6-v7 semantic design and deterministic reducers

tension_compiler.schedule_derivation: generic fixture source order filtered only by complete boolean claim support
renderer_visible: atomic claim span text with source_supported true
stable declared source_record_ids with authority, source hash, path, and line binding
only relevant compact typed predecessor outputs reopened from this run
tension_compiler.controller_only_source_revalidation: Before each render, reopen every declared frozen source file, verify its full storage SHA-256 against source_catalog, extract the exact declared inclusive line range, and require byte identity with the bound capsule excerpt. Full source bodies and excerpt text remain controller-only after validation.

forbidden: frozen answer literals outside the independent scorer/oracle
cell-specific control-flow branches for expected answers
subject-visible scorer keys, expected payloads, prior outputs, or prior findings
acceptance weakening, retries, best-of, replacement, or hidden semantic repair
required_holdouts: missing, duplicate, overlapping, and gapped claim spans and source closure
source full-byte hash and exact line-range excerpt revalidation
excerpt tamper plus missing, extra, and reordered source projection rejection
last-claim false exclusion and supported true/false reduction
mutated or unbound candidate-v4 harness rejection before dynamic import
prose, pretty JSON, duplicate keys, extra content and keys
wrong type and enum, canonical semantic pass and fail
missing text and prohibited activity are permanent subject failures
two and three byte-identical output_text finals normalize
different and whitespace-different final bytes reject
prohibited activity and mixed content prevent normalization
